# @mrmeg/expo-analytics

Docs: README.md (install and remove, server setup and mounting, client
trackers, server events and users, revenue, tracked links, metric definitions,
privacy, dashboard and query API, operations), LLM_USAGE.md (setup and rules),
llms-full.md (expanded contract).

Entrypoints — `@mrmeg/expo-analytics` (core tracker), `/web`, `/native`,
`/metrics` (pure report types and functions), `/server` (ingest, tables,
reports, dashboard). Bin: `expo-analytics <install|uninstall|status>`.

Rules:

- `/server` needs Node or Bun; never import it into an app bundle. `/native` is
  the only entry that imports `react-native` (an optional peer).
- The package ships no driver: wrap the host's client with `fromPostgresJs` or
  `fromPg`. `install()` is idempotent; call it on boot.
- Never send a user id from the client. The server attributes events with
  `resolveUserId(request)`; the tracker's `headers` carry the auth token.
- The dashboard and `/api/*` answer 404 until `isAdmin` is supplied.
- Event names are lowercase snake case; `$` names are reserved. Event maps and
  their props are `type` aliases, not interfaces.
- `identify(userId, { createdAt, excluded })` backfills sign-up dates and keeps
  staff and test accounts out of every metric.
- Revenue rows count toward MRR only with `providerSubscriptionId` and
  `periodEnd`; add the period to `@mrmeg/expo-purchases` ledger rows.
- Own SQL against the tables casts JSON parameters as `$1::text::jsonb`.
